광동헬스바이오(주) 2공장 제조 · 1일 2회 1정

이 제품은 나이아신 7mg, 마그네슘 94.5mg, 망간 0.9mg, 비오틴 30μg, 비타민 B1 0.6mg, 비타민 B12 4μg, 비타민 B2 0.7mg, 비타민 B6 0.75mg, 비타민 C 100mg, 비타민 D 5μg, 셀레늄 25μg, 아연 12mg, 엽산 200μg, 칼슘 210mg, 판토텐산 5mg를 표시량으로 담은 15원료 복합 건강기능식품입니다. 각 원료의 공식 인정 기능성은 아래와 같습니다.

  • 1일 2회(1정) 섭취로 나이아신 7mg, 마그네슘 94.5mg, 망간 0.9mg, 비오틴 30μg, 비타민 B1 0.6mg, 비타민 B12 4μg, 비타민 B2 0.7mg, 비타민 B6 0.75mg, 비타민 C 100mg, 비타민 D 5μg, 셀레늄 25μg, 아연 12mg, 엽산 200μg, 칼슘 210mg, 판토텐산 5mg

Health Functional FoodNiacin 7mgMagnesium 94.5mgManganese 0.9mgBiotin 30μgVitamin B1 0.6mgVitamin B12 4μgVitamin B2 0.7mgVitamin B6 0.75mgVitamin C 100mgVitamin D 5μgSelenium 25μgZinc 12mgFolate 200μgCalcium 210mgPantothenic acid 5mg2 times a day

키즈쿠마츄어블Niacin · Magnesium · Manganese · Biotin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Selenium · Zinc · Folate · Calcium · Pantothenic acid

Made by 광동헬스바이오(주) 2공장 · 2 times a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 7mg of Niacin, 94.5mg of Magnesium, 0.9mg of Manganese, 30μg of Biotin, 0.6mg of Vitamin B1, 4μg of Vitamin B12, 0.7mg of Vitamin B2, 0.75mg of Vitamin B6, 100mg of Vitamin C, 5μg of Vitamin D, 25μg of Selenium, 12mg of Zinc, 200μg of Folate, 210mg of Calcium, 5mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • 2 times a day (1 tablet): 7mg Niacin, 94.5mg Magnesium, 0.9mg Manganese, 30μg Biotin, 0.6mg Vitamin B1, 4μg Vitamin B12, 0.7mg Vitamin B2, 0.75mg Vitamin B6, 100mg Vitamin C, 5μg Vitamin D, 25μg Selenium, 12mg Zinc, 200μg Folate, 210mg Calcium, 5mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 광동헬스바이오(주) 2공장

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Magnesium
    • Needed to help maintain normal nerve and muscle function
    • Needed for energy utilisation
  • Manganese
    • Needed for energy utilisation
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for bone formation
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin D
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
  • Selenium
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Calcium
    • Needed for the formation of bones and teeth
    • Needed to help maintain normal nerve and muscle function
    • Needed for normal blood clotting
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

2 times a day1 tablet per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Niacin labelled (7mg / 2800mg), 80~150%
Magnesium labelled (94.5mg / 2800mg), 80~150%
Manganese labelled (0.9mg / 2800mg), 80~150%
Biotin labelled (30μg / 2800mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B1 labelled (0.6mg / 2800mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B12 labelled (4μg / 2800mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (0.7mg / 2800mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (0.75mg / 2800mg), 80~150%
Vitamin C labelled (100mg / 2800mg), 80~150%
Vitamin D labelled (5μg / 2800mg), 80~180%
Selenium labelled (25μg / 2800mg), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (12mg / 2800mg), 80~150%
Folate labelled (200μg / 2800mg), 80~150%
Calcium labelled (210mg / 2800mg), 80~150%
Pantothenic acid labelled (5mg / 2800mg), 80~180%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미·이취가 없으며 점박이가 있는 흰 보라색의 원형 츄어블정제
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage 직사광선을 피하고 서늘한 곳에 보관 및 유통(실온)

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Magnesium · Manganese · Biotin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Selenium · Zinc · Folate · Calcium · Pantothenic acid together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Consult a professional if you have hypercalcaemia or take medication · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product
